location.name: The shack

view.text: A lamp, a table, a ledger blotched with tidewater. A rope handle marks the boards over the harbour.
The ledger is in your coat. The lamp burns. The rope in the floor waits.
The door, and beside it a clerk's coat on a hook.

location.asset:
The tide has taken the ink. What is left is the dent of a name, Thomas Voss, and the dent of an hour already passed.
Under it, in the folder's hand: say it where the floor is dry.
The lamp is turned low and full of oil. Somebody meant to come back to this table.
A tide clerk's coat, olive, brass buttons, dry on its hook. His hat is under it. Nobody walked out of here into this rain.
A tide clerk's coat, olive, brass buttons, dry on its hook. The man under your window was wearing its twin.
location.ending: The ring comes up in your hand. Black water waits under the shack, and the face from the folder rises to meet you.
The hour is in your coat, and still you open the floor. The face rises, because you brought his name down to the water.
